Department of AYUSH – National AYUSH Mission (AYUSH Public Health Programmes)
AYUSH Medical Officer, Pharmacist, Psychosocial Counselor, Yoga Professional
Varies by post – Rs.15,000/- to Rs.40,000/- consolidated per month; Psychosocial Counselor @ Rs.500/- per session
Offline – in person or through Registered Post

content_sections.heading: About Mulugu District AYUSH Recruitment
content_sections.text: The notice comes from the Office of the District Collector and Magistrate, Mulugu District, Government of Telangana. Under G.O.Rt.No.1508, Fin (HRM.VII) Dept., dated 21/08/2026, the Director, Department of AYUSH, T.G., Secunderabad, asked the Collector to fill the posts sanctioned for Mulugu District through the District Selection Committee. The posts are meant only for the AYUSH Department's Public Health Programme under the National AYUSH Mission. Selected candidates will work under the administrative control of the Director, Department of AYUSH, T.G., Secunderabad.

content_sections.heading: Important Dates
content_sections.text: Applications received after the due date will be summarily rejected. The District Selection Committee is not responsible for postal delays, so a posted application must reach the office by 31 October 2026. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: All 7 posts are for Mulugu District. The roster points are printed for each post. The roster points for the four AYUSH Medical Officer posts break down to 2 OC, 1 SC (Group II) and 1 BC-A.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Must possess a Degree in Ayurveda or Unani or Homoeopathy or Naturopathy system awarded by a University in India established or incorporated by or under Central Act or State Act or Provincial Act or an institution recognized by the University Grants Commission or any statutory Board of the State Government after having undergone a regular course of institutional study in the respective systems, both in theory and practice for a period not less than 4 ½ years duration in a teaching institution recognized by the university or state government with one year compulsory internship. Must possess any of the following qualifications: D Pharmacy, B Pharmacy or Pharma D. Must be registered with the Telangana Pharmacy Council. Must possess a Post Graduate Degree in Master of Social Work (MSW) awarded by a University in India established or incorporated by or under Central Act or an Institution recognized by the University Grants Commission. Must possess any of the following qualifications: A Degree in Naturopathy system awarded by a University in India established or incorporated by or under Central Act or State Act or Provincial Act or an institution recognized by the University Grants Commission or any statutory Board of the State Government after having undergone a regular course of institutional study in the respective systems, both in theory and practice for a period not less than 4 ½ years duration in a teaching institution recognized by the university or state government with one year compulsory internship; OR A 'Diploma in Naturopathy and Yogic Sciences' awarded by a University in India established or incorporated by or under Central Act or State Act or Provincial Act or an institution recognized by the University Grants Commission or any statutory Board of the State Government. The notice prints no experience requirement for any of the four posts. It also says that the remuneration and educational qualifications for each category shall be as specified in the approved guidelines and Government Orders. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit and Relaxation
content_sections.text: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 44 years, both reckoned as on 1 July 2026 (01/07/2026). The following relaxations apply to the maximum age limit as per rules:

rows.relaxation: 3 (Three) years in addition to the length of service in armed forces

content_sections.heading: Reservation and Unit of Appointment
content_sections.text: The rules of reservation for Community, Disability and Ex-service Men will be strictly observed as per the Telangana State and Subordinate Service Rules, 1996, read with the relevant specific rules that apply. Reservation for local candidates applies as per the Presidential Order, with 95% local reservation.

rows.unit_of_appointment: Can apply in any District in the concerned Multi Zone, but selection shall be restricted to one District.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Recruitment is on an outsourcing basis up to 31.03.2027. After that, the services will be as per the need and subject to satisfactory performance. The posts are for AYUSH Public Health Programmes in Mulugu District, under the administrative control of the Director, Department of AYUSH, T.G., Secunderabad. For the Psychosocial Counselor post, a panel of eligible candidates may be empaneled. Empaneled candidates will be engaged on a call basis, as and when their services are required.

rows.consolidated_pay_per_month_in_rs: @ Rs.500/- per session & atleast 200 visits in a year (on Call)

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The District Selection Committee of the District Health Society will make the selection on the basis of marks out of 100: up to 90 for the qualifying examination and up to 10 for age. A merit list follows, and then a selection list. For the AYUSH Medical Officer, Pharmacist, Psychosocial Counselor and Yoga Professional posts, 90 marks will be allotted on the basis of the marks obtained in the qualifying examination. For all the posts, 10 marks are given for age. Age is counted from 18 years: 0.5 mark for each completed year, up to a maximum of 10 marks. Age is reckoned as on 1 July 2026. The notice gives these examples: A candidate who completes 20 years as on 1 July 2026 gets 1.0 mark. A candidate who completes 30 years as on 1 July 2026 gets 6.0 marks. A candidate who completes 40 years as on 1 July 2026 gets 10.0 marks. A merit list will be prepared from the marks under these criteria and displayed on the website for transparency. The selection list will be prepared from the finalized merit list, following the rule of reservation and the Presidential Order.

content_sections.text: Download the application form and the instructions from the official website of Mulugu District. The notice does not print the website address. Fill in the application form and paste one photograph on it. Enclose self-attested copies of the certificates listed under Documents Required, with an acknowledgment card. Submit the application in person or through Registered Post between 26 October 2026 and 31 October 2026, from 10:30 AM to 05:00 PM on working days. For Registered Post, the address handwritten in the notice is: AYUSH Cell, O/o DM&HO Office, IDOC-Mulugu, Pin: 506343. Section VIII of the notice says that filled-in forms go to the O/o. the Collector & District Magistrate, Mulugu District. The handwritten correction on page 1 names the AYUSH Cell, IDOC-Mulugu, O/o DM&HO as the place to submit. Applications received after the due date will be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Enclose self-attested copies of the following with the application form: SSC or equivalent examination Intermediate or 10+2 examination Qualifying Examination Pass Certificate Marks memos of all the years (qualifying examination) Registration Certificates of Board of Indian Medicine (for AYUSH Doctor with PG Qualification and Medical Officer Posts) Registration Certificate of the Telangana Pharmacy Council (for Pharmacist post) Latest Caste Certificates issued by the Tahsildar / MRO concerned Study Certificate for the years from 4th Class to 10th class and, in case of Private Study, Residency Certificate from the Tahsildar / MRO concerned PH Certificate in respect of candidates claiming reservation under PH Quota Relevant Certificates in respect of candidates claiming Ex-service man quota 1 Photograph duly pasted on the application form Acknowledgment card

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Mulugu District Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 7 posts: 4 AYUSH Medical Officer, 1 Pharmacist, 1 Psychosocial Counselor and 1 Yoga Professional, all in Mulugu District.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications are received from 26 October 2026 to 31 October 2026, between 10:30 AM and 05:00 PM on working days. Applications received after the due date will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the AYUSH Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: A Degree in Ayurveda or Unani or Homoeopathy or Naturopathy system, from a regular course of not less than 4 ½ years in a recognized teaching institution, with one year compulsory internship.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the Pharmacist post?
faq.answer: D Pharmacy, B Pharmacy or Pharma D, and the candidate must be registered with the Telangana Pharmacy Council.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum is 44 years as on 1 July 2026. The maximum is relaxed by 5 years for SC, ST and BC candidates, by 3 years plus the length of armed forces service for Ex-Service men, and by 10 years for disabled persons.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for each post?
faq.answer: Consolidated pay per month is Rs.40,000/- for the AYUSH Medical Officer, Rs.15,000/- for the Pharmacist and Rs.28,000/- for the Yoga Professional. The Psychosocial Counselor gets Rs.500/- per session, with atleast 200 visits in a year (on call).

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Download the application form from the official website of Mulugu District. Submit it with self-attested certificates in person or by Registered Post to AYUSH Cell, O/o DM&HO Office, IDOC-Mulugu, Pin: 506343, by 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: On marks out of 100: up to 90 for the marks in the qualifying examination and up to 10 for age (0.5 mark for each completed year above 18, as on 1 July 2026). The merit list will be displayed on the website, and the selection list will follow the rule of reservation and the Presidential Order.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The posts are on an outsourcing basis up to 31 March 2027. After that, the services will be as per the need and subject to satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q10. Can an AYUSH Medical Officer candidate from another district apply?
faq.answer: Yes. The AYUSH Medical Officer post is a Multi Zonal cadre post, so a candidate can apply in any district in the concerned Multi Zone, but selection is restricted to one district.
